verdict.root_cause: The booking controls for the Friday show and individual seats are not reachable when moving through the page with the Tab key. The keyboard reaches only the quantity controls.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent followed the required keyboard-only method and used Tab to move through the page. It did not click, type into an unrelated field, or make a wrong selection. The required Friday and seat controls were skipped by the page's keyboard focus order, so the agent could not cause or recover from this outcome.
verdict.bug_title: Friday show and seat controls are skipped in keyboard navigation

signals.excerpt: Tab skips Friday and all seats, leaving only quantity controls; keyboard-only booking cannot be completed.

verdict.suggestion: Make the Friday show option and every available seat reachable by Tab, with a clear keyboard focus indicator. Retest the full booking flow using only Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, and arrow keys.
verdict.one_liner: Keyboard-only users cannot choose Friday or select seats, so they cannot complete this booking.

objective:
You are a blind user who navigates with the keyboard only (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, arrow keys).
The mouse does not work and the screen is black.
Book 2 seats in row F for Friday's show.
At checkout use the name Alex Rivera, the email alex@example.com and the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 with expiry 12/30 and CVC 123.
Verify, by reading the page text as a screen reader would, that the page says "You're going! Order #ENC-4821 · Row F · Seats 14–15".
